{{RV|type=function

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.34

|gr1= Vehicles

|descr= Update Firing From Vehicle feature depending on condition defined in turret's config.

|s1= vehicle call [[BIS_fnc_ffvUpdate]]

|p1= vehicle: [[Object]]

|r1= [[Nothing]]

|x1= <sqf>

{

	_vehicle call BIS_fnc_ffvUpdate;
};
</sqf>
